Mesh

class ibfs.mesh.Mesh(x0: float, x1: float, nx: int, y0: float, y1: float, ny: int)[source]

Bases: object

Holds information on a two-dimensional uniform mesh with \(\Delta = \Delta x = \Delta y\) over the spatial domain

\[D = \left[ x_0 - \frac{\Delta}{2}, x_1 + \frac{\Delta}{2} \right] \times \left[ y_0 - \frac{\Delta}{2}, y_1 + \frac{\Delta}{2} \right]\]

The grid is staggered, so \(x\)-velocities are stored at right/left cell faces, \(y\)-velocities at top/bottom cell faces, and the pressure is stored at cell centers. This class also holds two-dimensional arrays to store the \(x\) velocity field, \(y\) velocity field and the pressure.

Parameters:

  • x0 (float) – \(x\) location of the left-most cell center

  • x1 (float) – \(x\) location of the right-most cell center

  • nx (int) – number of cells in the x direction

  • y0 (float) – \(y\) location of the bottom cell center

  • y1 (float) – \(y\) location of the top cell center

  • ny (int) – number of cells in the y direction
